title: Luganda speech-recognition smoke test (3 Common Voice clips + 2 failure clips)
status: Small hackathon evaluation. NOT clinical validation. 3 real clips is far too few to estimate accuracy.

dataset.name: Mozilla Common Voice Corpus 17.0, Luganda (lg), test split
dataset.audio: Local only, never committed or deployed: resources/datasets/raw/common-voice-lg/ (gitignored). Re-download with evaluation/luganda-asr/fetch_clips.py.
dataset.note: Only 3 clips were downloaded (HTTP range request on the first 2 MB of the test archive). Transcripts copied exactly; no Luganda was written or translated by the team.

model.name: allandclive/whisper-tiny-luganda-v2
model.base: openai/whisper-tiny, fine-tuned for Luganda (model card: Common Voice 16.1 and FLEURS)

safety_layer.rule: empty transcript or confidence below threshold -> "Not sure. Please ask a person."

runtime.memory_note: Whole Python + PyTorch process on a laptop, not phone RAM. The model itself added about 45 MB.
runtime.decoding: greedy, max 96 new tokens, no language model
